_comment: Review cut 1 of the BPO film: picture only, no voice-over yet. Every range below was chosen by reading the takes frame by frame (journal 2026-09-23); the fill is sped up under an elapsed-time counter driven by SOURCE time, so it lands on the true Submit-to-result interval.

take1._bg_why: Cursorful's backdrop, sampled at the frame edge; the 1064-line frame is padded to 1080 with it so no seam shows

paint._why: tab strip: tab titles and window controls, erased to the strip's own colour
address bar: C:/Users/<user>/Downloads/... is a local path with the user name in it
eight tabs all titled 'untitled' -- reads as a debugging session
local file path with the user name
PDF viewer title 'untitled' -- the synthetic listings have no document title

take3._note: takes 3 and 4 were recorded as one file; Submit is at 58.00, the result message at 168.88 (measured to the frame)

blur._why: 'processed in 1 minute and 28 seconds' is the server's interval; the counter shows click-to-result (1:50) and the two must not sit side by side disagreeing

edl._why: the blank form: 2.5 s on page 1, the scroll, then section III held -- the grid the film is about
on to page 3; skips 0:21-0:27 where the zoom-out made page 2 unreadable
the eight documents; the first 8.5 s sat on one tab

form loaded, the eight documents chosen and listed
to Submit (58.00); drops 11 s of the cursor hovering over it
